note: Pack admission gates v2. A new rule, not an edit of np1's frozen packAdmission (np1.json is unchanged and np1 runs keep its rule). Applies to packs checked with pack-check.v2; a v1 verdict has no pitched or valuesStated and so fails every fact. First measured by a Sol-only recheck of five np1 packs (scratchpad/quality-prd/lab/np1/rootcause/pack-gates.md).
rule: A pack fact is used by the grounded and packed arms only if BOTH checkers (luna, sol) answered correct = yes AND neither answered supportedByEvidence = no, pitched = no or valuesStated = no; a missing verdict or a missing pitched/valuesStated field fails. Applied in code (pack-arms.ts admitPack with gates) from the verdicts recorded in the pack's report.
